verdict.rationale: DeepSeek is itself an AI model and API, so users get AI-generated analysis by passing their data to it. The docs support this through thinking-mode reasoning, JSON output, multimodal vision input and function calling, which can pull data from external tools. However, nothing in the evidence shows a built-in feature that connects to a user's data or proactively surfaces insights and suggestions inside the product; the user has to supply the data and build the workflow. Missing for 10: native data connectors or a built-in insights feature, proactive suggestions, hands-on evidence of data-analysis quality.
